name: BODACC
description: Official French Bulletin of Civil and Commercial Announcements. Search incorporations, establishment creations, modifications, removals, business sales, collective proceedings, and account filings through the free public Opendatasoft API. Some records concern natural persons; downstream reuse remains subject to data-protection rules.

tools.name: get_dataset_metadata
tools.description: Get current BODACC dataset metadata, field definitions, update times, and API links.

tools.name: search_announcements
tools.description: Search BODACC announcements with Opendatasoft SQL-like where expressions. Filter on dateparution, familleavis, typeavis, registre/SIREN, commercant, department, region, city, or keywords; order newest first for lead generation.

select.description: Comma-separated fields or ODS select expression.

where.description: ODS filter expression, for example `dateparution >= date'2026-08-01' AND familleavis = 'creation'`.

tools.name: get_announcement
tools.description: Get one BODACC announcement by its record identifier.

record_id.description: BODACC record id returned by search_announcements.

tools.name: facet_announcements
tools.description: Return value counts for BODACC fields such as announcement family, department, region, or publication date, optionally constrained by a where expression.

facet.description: Field to facet, for example familleavis_lib, numerodepartement, or region_nom_officiel.
